title: Review duplicates
intro: Logins that look like the same account stored more than once: the same username on the same site, or on a brand's other country sites. Pick the one to keep: the others' websites are added to it and they move to Recently Deleted, where you can restore them for 30 days.
differentPasswords: The passwords are different: check before merging.
differentHint: The other passwords are not lost: they go into the password history of the login you keep.
merge: Merge into the selected login ({n} to Recently Deleted)
